statement:
I'll look up the column record first to verify the details before posting the grades.
I notice a critical mismatch: the marking file shows scores out of 10 (lowest 6, highest 10), but the Canvas column is set for 100 points possible. Posting these scores as-is would record them as 6/100 to 10/100, which would be drastically incorrect grading.

Before proceeding, I need clarification: Should I post these scores scaled to the 100-point column (multiplying by 10), or should the points possible in Canvas be corrected to 10 first? 

This is not safe and correct to proceed with posting at face value, as it would severely undergrade all 180 students. Please confirm the intended approach.
judge_text:
WRONG
It states the 100 points possible mismatches the out-of-10 scores and posting as-is "would record them as 6/100 to 10/100, which would be drastically incorrect."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
